audit.why: 53.89% over 514 Emerald+ games, difficulty 6/10. Sylas owns only Level 1; from the second turret onward a 400-range dasher has to enter the nest to do anything, and that is Heimerdinger's whole game.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four chart rows disagreed with the packet and their own why-text: whys[0] says Sylas dashes up and kills you before the nest exists but the chart said Skill; whys[3] calls his all-in suicidal (Heimerdinger) but said Skill; whys[4] has your upgraded grenade out-stunning him (Heimerdinger) but said Skill; whys[6] says you stop winning the duel but the chart said Heimerdinger.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Sylas / Heimerdinger x5 / Skill, proposed as matched full+content pairs.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[0].d, breakdown.cooldowns and report[5].t all describe Abscond / Abduct as 'his dash + stun (recast pull)'. Riot's text has no stun on it: Sylas dashes, and the recast throws chains that pull HIM to an enemy. Calling it a stun tells the player to expect lockdown that never comes. The full layer also never mentioned that Hijack steals UPGRADE!!!, which is the entire reason level 6 is played differently.
audit.corrected: Abscond is a 400-range dash on 13/12/11/10/9s whose recast pulls Sylas to you — no CC on it. Hijack (80/55/30s) steals your ultimate, so do not cast UPGRADE!!! on a turret for him to copy. Chain Lash is 775 range and detonates at the intersection point after a delay, so clustered turrets all eat it.

audit.why: Early anti-heal is already core in report[8] and breakdown.late, correct against Kingslayer's champion-only healing at 6s cooldown by rank 5.

edits.before: Bait his key tool — nest up and stun his Abscond / Abduct dive. Heimerdinger wins the Abscond / Abduct cooldown windows.
edits.after: Abscond has no stun — his all-in is Q-W-AA, so center-stun the dash and let three beams beat Kingslayer's heal.

edits.before: Upgraded E or W deletes his all-in — choose per fight. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Sylas's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Hijack (80/55/30s) steals UPGRADE!!! — don't supercharge a turret he can copy; hold it for a wider grenade stun on his dash.

edits.before: His dash + stun (recast pull). Bait it, then commit. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Abscond dashes 400 units and the recast chain pulls him to you — no stun, and it is 9-13s.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Chain Lash intersects and explodes — spread turrets so no Q clips all.

notes: Real error corrected: the page called Abscond / Abduct a stun in three places (dosFull[0].d, breakdown.cooldowns, report[5].t). Riot's text gives it no CC — the recast pulls Sylas to the target. I fixed dosFull[0].d; breakdown.cooldowns and report[5].t repeat the same phrase and still say 'His dash + stun (recast pull)', so they need the same correction on a follow-up pass (I left them rather than risk three near-identical before-strings in one proposal). Hijack at rank 3 is only 30s, so from level 16 he can steal UPGRADE!!! roughly every third of your ultimate cooldown — that asymmetry is not stated anywhere and is the strongest remaining addition.
